The '''Dyrswo''' '''Desert''', also known as the '''Dyrswo''' '''Steppe''', is the largest desert in its region and ranks among the notable deserts worldwide by area. It spans approximately 737,625 square kilometres (around 458,338 mi²). The desert lies primarily within [[Jathua]] and [[Taniduna]], bounded by the [[Okaren Mountains]] to the south and the ocean or plain to the north. To the east, the desert transitions into the [[Coroa]], while its central areas are dominated by shrubs and herbaceous plant species. In regions with higher precipitation, these shrubs give way to grasses.
[[File:Landmannalaugar desert.jpg|thumb|Desert landscape at the edge of Diauclao, [[Taoisia]].]]
Topographically, the Dyrswo Desert consists of alternating [[wikipedia:Plateau|plateaus]] and [[wikipedia:Massif|massifs]], intersected by a very small minor river while having the remnants of major canyons. Its southern parts gradually merge into the [[Okaren Mountains]].
